title: AgentChangeBench: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Goal-Shift Robustness in Conversational AI
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models (MTI-LLM)
authors_zh: Manik Rana, Calissa Man, Anotida Expected Msiiwa, Jeffrey Paine, Kevin Zhu, Sunishchal Dev, Vasu Sharma, Ahan M R
paper_type_zh: 目标变更对话智能体环境评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究 tool-use agent、用户模拟器、goal-shift 评测与混合反馈审计的读者
one_line: AgentChangeBench evaluates 315 banking, airline, and retail goal-shift tasks through simulated tool-use episodes and mixed environment/LLM metrics, but its 2,835-sequence mapping and supplementary release remain insufficiently pinned for replay or training reuse.
AgentChangeBench 用 315 个银行、航空与零售 goal-shift 任务及混合环境/LLM 指标评测对话 agent，但 2,835 条 sequence 的映射和补充发布不足以支持 replay 或训练复用。
why: It separates final task progress, tool validity, repeated actions, and post-shift adaptation instead of collapsing an agent episode into pass/fail, while exposing the audit burden created by LLM judges, closed-model simulators, inherited public tasks, and unversioned environment artifacts.
inclusion_reason: AgentChangeBench makes mid-dialogue intent change an explicit environment state/trajectory object and exposes a mixed feedback contract over tool execution, communication, redundancy, and adaptation latency, while also illustrating why benchmark releases need pinned artifacts, judge calibration, and replay metadata.

title: Problem
问题
html:
AgentChangeBench asks whether a tool-using conversational agent can remain effective after the user's goal changes during an ongoing episode. The stable primary record is arXiv:2510.18170v1, submitted on 2025-10-20; the accepted venue is the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models (MTI-LLM), where the work appeared as a poster. The official arXiv, NeurIPS virtual, and MTI-LLM OpenReview pages support the bibliographic record. A parallel LAW @ NeurIPS 2025 OpenReview version is treated as version drift, not a separate paper.

The benchmark contains 315 declarative customer-service tasks: 50 banking, 100 airline, and 165 retail. Each task specifies a persona, known and unknown information, ordered goals, the number of required shifts, an initial environment state, allowed actions/tools, evaluation criteria, natural-language assertions, and information that the assistant must communicate. The evaluated episode then adds user and assistant turns, assistant-only tool calls, API observations, goal-shift events, post-shift acknowledgment/tool/outcome timestamps, transfer events, and metric outputs. This task-plus-episode structure is the reason for assigning the paper to environment_agent_trajectory_data.

The neighboring problem is ordinary static task success. AgentChangeBench instead makes mid-dialogue change observable as an evaluation event and separates communication, action execution, redundant tool use, and recovery timing. Its shifts are nevertheless predeclared, ordered, and often explicitly signaled; the work does not cover implicit, ambiguous, interleaved, adversarial, code, browser, OS, or robotic goal drift. It is therefore a focused evaluation surface rather than a general model of evolving user intent.

The paper reports 2,835 task sequences, but no accessible manifest maps that number to task IDs or run records. Multiplying 315 tasks by three proprietary models and three runs yields 2,835, but that equality is a curator inference, not a published serialization contract. L4-depth analysis is possible from the paper and appendices for the task schema, construction pipeline, environment, metrics, results, and risks. The accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready, because the officially listed supplementary ZIP could not be retrieved and its contents, license, split, checksum, failure retention, and replay completeness remain unverified.

AgentChangeBench 研究 tool-use 对话 agent 在 episode 进行期间遇到用户目标变化后能否继续有效完成任务。稳定的主要记录是 2025 年 10 月 20 日提交的 arXiv:2510.18170v1；论文以 poster 形式被 NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Multi-Turn Interactions in Large Language Models (MTI-LLM) 接收。arXiv、NeurIPS virtual page 与 MTI-LLM OpenReview 官方页面共同支持这条书目信息。另一个 LAW @ NeurIPS 2025 OpenReview 版本属于版本漂移，不作为第二篇论文处理。

benchmark 包含 315 个声明式客服任务：banking 50 个、airline 100 个、retail 165 个。每个 task 指定 persona、已知与未知信息、有序 goals、required shift 数量、初始 environment state、允许的 action/tool、evaluation criteria、natural-language assertion 以及 assistant 必须传达的信息。评测 episode 随后加入 user/assistant turn、仅由 assistant 发起的 tool call、API observation、goal-shift event、变更后的 acknowledgment/tool/outcome 时间点、transfer event 与 metric output。正是这种 task-plus-episode 结构，使论文归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data。

相邻问题是普通的静态 task success；AgentChangeBench 则把对话中途的变化变成可观察评测事件，并分开衡量 communication、action execution、重复 tool use 与 recovery timing。不过，其 shift 预先声明、按顺序发生且通常有明确提示；论文不覆盖 implicit、ambiguous、interleaved 或 adversarial goal drift，也不涉及 code、browser、OS 或 robotic tool。因此它是聚焦的 evaluation surface，而不是对不断变化用户意图的通用建模。

论文报告 2,835 条 task sequence，但可访问材料没有 manifest 将这一数字映射到 task ID 或 run record。315 个 task × 3 个闭源模型 × 3 次运行恰好等于 2,835，但这只是 curator inference，不是论文明确给出的 serialization contract。论文与 appendix 足以支持对 task schema、构造 pipeline、environment、metric、结果和风险做 L4 深度分析；accepted metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready，因为官方列出的 supplementary ZIP 无法取回，其内容、license、split、checksum、failure retention 与 replay completeness 均未核验。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is an evaluation framework in which a customer-service task carries an ordered sequence of goals and the transcript is scored not only for final progress but also for how the assistant notices and responds to a shift. The task object determines required_shifts = len(goals) - 1; a persona-conditioned LLM user simulator exposes only known_info, follows the ordered goals, and never calls tools, while the evaluated assistant performs all domain-API interactions.

The evaluation surface is a full user-agent-tool episode over tau-bench-derived banking, airline, and retail APIs. The assistant observes user messages and tool/API responses; the evaluator observes the full transcript, tool-call names and arguments, API outcomes, allowed goal sequence, and task assertions. Shift markers are hidden from the evaluated assistant but available to post-hoc evaluation. The exact released serialization is unknown because the supplementary ZIP was not inspected.

The feedback contract is mixed rather than a single success bit. Task Success Rate (TSR) weights communication information at 0.25, action execution at 0.45, and natural-language assertions at 0.30. Tool Use Efficiency (TUE) combines tool correctness at 0.6 and parameter validity at 0.4. Tool Call Redundancy Rate (TCRR) counts exact duplicates within a three-turn window or calls to the same function beyond a batch threshold of two. Goal-Shift Recovery and Turns (GSRT) uses an undisclosed post-hoc LLM detector to identify acknowledgment, first relevant tool, and outcome turns; binary recovery requires acknowledgment and no transfer to a human, even when the relevant tool or shifted-goal outcome is absent. Separately, gpt-4o-mini judges communication relevance, clarity, helpfulness, and adherence to user intent from the full transcript.

The environment/API layer can observe executable calls, schema-valid parameters, API responses, state changes, and exact repeated-call patterns. The communication judge can assess transcript-level language but inherits snapshot, prompt, calibration, style, and verbosity sensitivity. The unspecified shift detector introduces a second learned-judgment surface whose model, prompt, calibration, and repeatability are unknown. Neither learned component establishes semantic correctness outside its rubric.

Compared with tau-bench-style static customer-service evaluation, the concrete change is to represent user-intent change as an ordered task field and attach recovery latency and acknowledgment measures to the resulting episode. Compared with tau2-bench, which emphasizes dual control and executable action by both agent and user, AgentChangeBench retains assistant-only tool control and emphasizes mid-dialogue goal transitions. Its direction signal is therefore dynamic-intent evaluation, not a new training objective or proof that the resulting trajectories are high-quality training data.

论文的核心贡献是一套 evaluation framework：客服 task 携带有序 goal sequence，transcript 不仅按最终进展打分，还衡量 assistant 是否发现并响应 goal shift。task object 规定 required_shifts = len(goals) - 1；persona-conditioned LLM user simulator 只暴露 known_info，依次执行 ordered goals，且从不调用工具，所有 domain API interaction 都由被评测 assistant 执行。

evaluation surface 是运行在 tau-bench-derived banking、airline 与 retail API 上的完整 user-agent-tool episode。assistant 能观察 user message 与 tool/API response；evaluator 能观察完整 transcript、tool-call name/argument、API outcome、允许的 goal sequence 与 task assertion。shift marker 对被评测 assistant 隐藏，但供 post-hoc evaluation 使用。由于 supplementary ZIP 未被检查，准确的 release serialization 仍为 unknown。

反馈契约是 mixed，而不是单一 success bit。Task Success Rate (TSR) 对 communication information、action execution 与 natural-language assertion 的权重分别为 0.25、0.45、0.30。Tool Use Efficiency (TUE) 由 tool correctness 0.6 与 parameter validity 0.4 组成。Tool Call Redundancy Rate (TCRR) 统计三轮窗口内完全相同的重复调用，或同一 function 在一个 batch 中超过阈值 2 的调用。Goal-Shift Recovery and Turns (GSRT) 使用未披露的 post-hoc LLM detector 定位 acknowledgment、first relevant tool 与 outcome turn；binary recovery 只要求已经 acknowledgment 且没有 transfer to human，即使缺少 relevant tool 或 shifted-goal outcome 也可能算恢复。另有 gpt-4o-mini 读取完整 transcript，判断 communication 的 relevance、clarity、helpfulness 与对 user intent 的 adherence。

environment/API 层能够观察可执行 call、schema-valid parameter、API response、state change 与完全相同的 repeated-call pattern。communication judge 可以评估 transcript-level language，但受 model snapshot、prompt、calibration、style 与 verbosity 影响。未披露的 shift detector 构成第二个 learned-judgment surface，其 model、prompt、calibration 与 repeatability 均为 unknown。这两个 learned component 都不能证明 rubric 之外的语义正确性。

与 tau-bench 风格的静态客服评测相比，实际变化是把用户意图改变表示为 ordered task field，并给 episode 附加 recovery latency 与 acknowledgment 指标。与强调 dual control、agent 和 user 都能执行动作的 tau2-bench 相比，AgentChangeBench 保留 assistant-only tool control，重点是对话中途的 goal transition。因此它代表的是 dynamic-intent evaluation 方向，而不是新的 training objective，也没有证明这些 trajectory 是高质量训练数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction and evaluation pipeline is:

  1. Source and task design. The authors define banking, airline, and retail workflows. The paper reports 50 original banking tasks, 50 reused tau-bench airline templates, 114 reused tau-bench retail templates, and additional original scenarios created through human writing and LLM assistance. The disclosed components sum to 314 rather than 315, so one record or the meaning of the “50 newly generated scenarios” statement requires release-level reconciliation.
  2. Schema-guided generation. Appendix A describes domain analysis, tool definition, task-template creation, persona integration, and goal-shift integration. An undisclosed generator receives a JSON schema plus five Markdown reference files and returns ten candidate tasks per batch. Its model, prompt, decoding settings, number of batches, acceptance yield, and rejected candidates are unknown.
  3. Manual filtering and QA. Each generated batch is reviewed for valid tool parameters and database consistency, enough known_info for the user simulator, and communicate_info restricted to facts derived from tool responses. Appendix B additionally reports manual review of 10% of tasks, criteria cross-checking, inter-rater reliability analysis, and regular updates, but gives no annotator count, sampling rule, reliability statistic, adjudication protocol, or revision log.
  4. Goal-shift annotation. Ordered goals, initial state, allowable actions, assertions, information to communicate, and required_shifts are attached to each task. Transitions follow progression rules and markers remain hidden from the evaluated assistant.
  5. Episode generation. A persona-conditioned LLM user simulator reveals only known information and follows the ordered goals; the evaluated assistant converses and alone calls the controlled domain tools. The tau-bench-derived harness allows one tool call per turn, validates calls against API responses, and resets environment state between independent runs.
  6. Post-hoc scoring. The harness calculates TSR, TUE, and TCRR from communication, actions, assertions, parameters, API results, and exact-call patterns. gpt-4o-mini supplies the communication judgment. An unspecified LLM detector identifies post-shift acknowledgment, relevant-tool, and outcome turns for GSRT.
  7. Outputs and use. The output is a scored episode/shift record and aggregate benchmark result. The standard proprietary-model protocol runs every task three times; Appendix E uses one run per domain for Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. The paper reports evaluation only—no SFT, preference learning, reward-model training, RLVR, process supervision, or agent training.

Reproduction requires more than the declarative task JSON. A credible replay freeze must pin the exact tau-bench-derived harness commit, banking/airline/retail database snapshots and APIs, user-simulator prompt/model/seed, evaluated-model API snapshots, judge and shift-detector prompts/snapshots, tool schemas, turn/token/retry budgets, sampling parameters, per-run seeds, and metric code. None of these are fully pinned in the accessible sources.

The official MTI-LLM OpenReview record lists a supplementary ZIP that the paper says contains the full benchmark, evaluation-harness configurations, and experimental artifacts. The ZIP was not retrievable during curation. Its file inventory, task-to-sequence manifest, code revision, dependency lock, database snapshot, train/dev/test or old/new split manifest, checksums, data/code license, retained success/failure runs, and deterministic replay instructions must therefore remain unknown rather than inferred.

构造与评测 pipeline 如下：

  1. 来源与任务设计。 作者定义 banking、airline 与 retail workflow。论文报告 50 个 original banking task、50 个复用的 tau-bench airline template、114 个复用的 tau-bench retail template，以及由 human writing 与 LLM assistance 创建的 additional original scenario。已披露组成相加为 314 而不是 315，因此有一个 record，或“50 newly generated scenarios”表述的含义，需要在 release 层调和。
  2. Schema-guided generation。 Appendix A 描述 domain analysis、tool definition、task-template creation、persona integration 与 goal-shift integration。一个未披露的 generator 接收 JSON schema 与 5 个 Markdown reference file，每个 batch 产生 10 个 candidate task。其 model、prompt、decoding setting、batch 数、acceptance yield 与 rejected candidate 均为 unknown。
  3. 人工过滤与 QA。 每个生成 batch 都会检查 tool parameter 与 database consistency、user simulator 所需的 known_info 是否充分，以及 communicate_info 是否仅包含由 tool response 得到的事实。Appendix B 还报告对 10% task 做 manual review、交叉检查 evaluation criteria、进行 inter-rater reliability analysis 并定期更新，但没有给出 annotator 数量、sampling rule、reliability statistic、adjudication protocol 或 revision log。
  4. Goal-shift annotation。 每个 task 都附有 ordered goals、initial state、allowable actions、assertion、information to communicate 与 required_shifts。transition 遵循 progression rule，marker 对被评测 assistant 隐藏。
  5. Episode generation。 persona-conditioned LLM user simulator 只揭示 known information 并依次执行 ordered goals；被评测 assistant 参与对话且独自调用受控 domain tool。tau-bench-derived harness 每轮允许一个 tool call，根据 API response 验证调用，并在 independent run 之间重置 environment state。
  6. Post-hoc scoring。 harness 从 communication、action、assertion、parameter、API result 与 exact-call pattern 计算 TSR、TUE、TCRR。gpt-4o-mini 提供 communication judgment；未披露的 LLM detector 为 GSRT 识别变更后的 acknowledgment、relevant-tool 与 outcome turn。
  7. 输出与用途。 输出是带分数的 episode/shift record 与 aggregate benchmark result。标准闭源模型协议对每个 task 运行 3 次；Appendix E 的 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 每个 domain 仅运行 1 次。论文只报告 evaluation，没有 SFT、preference learning、reward-model training、RLVR、process supervision 或 agent training。

复现所需信息远超声明式 task JSON。可信的 replay freeze 必须固定准确的 tau-bench-derived harness commit、banking/airline/retail database snapshot 与 API、user-simulator prompt/model/seed、被评测 model API snapshot、judge 与 shift-detector prompt/snapshot、tool schema、turn/token/retry budget、sampling parameter、逐 run seed 与 metric code。可访问来源没有完整固定这些项目。

MTI-LLM OpenReview 官方记录列出一个 supplementary ZIP；论文称其包含 full benchmark、evaluation-harness configuration 与 experimental artifact。该 ZIP 在本次整理中无法取回。因此其 file inventory、task-to-sequence manifest、code revision、dependency lock、database snapshot、train/dev/test 或 old/new split manifest、checksum、data/code license、保留的 success/failure run 与 deterministic replay instruction 都必须保持 unknown，不能推断。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates GPT-4o, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and Gemini-2.5-Flash with three independent runs per task and an environment reset between runs; Appendix E adds a single-run-per-domain Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct baseline. Immutable model/API snapshots, seeds, decoding settings, turn/token limits, retry rules, and judge repetitions are not disclosed, so the reported comparisons are tied to incompletely specified closed-model configurations.

Table 5 reports airline-new goal-shift recovery of 92.2% for GPT-4o, 79.2% for Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and 48.6% for Gemini-2.5-Flash. The same table reports retail-new TCRR of 89.14% for GPT-4o and 66.45% for Gemini-2.5-Flash. These are author-reported benchmark outcomes, not independently reproduced results. They show that the proposed metrics distinguish model/configuration behavior on the stated tasks; they do not establish data quality, simulator fidelity, replayability, or suitability for training.

The paper also contains material internal inconsistencies. Table 7 and the immediately following persona-analysis prose give different recovery values for several personas, so persona-specific recovery numbers should not be reused until the raw metric inputs are reconciled. The 315-task total is not transparently recovered from the stated source components, which add to 314. The abstract's 2,835 sequences are not tied to an accessible record manifest; the 315 × 3 models × 3 runs explanation remains arithmetic inference.

The evidence for construction and QA is procedural rather than release-verified. Appendix A supplies the task schema, ten-candidate generation batches, five Markdown references, manual database/tool checks, and goal-shift integration. Appendix B states three runs, state reset, a 10% task review, criteria cross-checking, inter-rater reliability analysis, and updates. It does not publish the generator/judge/simulator configuration, annotator statistics, rejected items, raw run table, or revision history in the accessible text.

Artifact evidence stops at the listing boundary. The MTI-LLM OpenReview page officially exposes a supplementary-material endpoint and the paper says that the full benchmark, harness configurations, and experiments are released there. Because the ZIP itself could not be retrieved, the Card does not claim that code, task JSON, run logs, split files, licenses, hashes, or replay fixtures were inspected. No separate official GitHub, project page, or Hugging Face dataset was confirmed.

论文使用 GPT-4o、Claude-3.7-Sonnet 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash，对每个 task 做 3 次 independent run，并在 run 之间重置 environment；Appendix E 还加入 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，每个 domain 只运行 1 次。immutable model/API snapshot、seed、decoding setting、turn/token limit、retry rule 与 judge repetition 均未披露，因此比较绑定在规格不完整的闭源模型配置上。

Table 5 报告 airline-new 的 goal-shift recovery：GPT-4o 为 92.2%，Claude-3.7-Sonnet 为 79.2%，Gemini-2.5-Flash 为 48.6%。同一表格报告 retail-new TCRR：GPT-4o 为 89.14%，Gemini-2.5-Flash 为 66.45%。这些是作者报告、尚未独立复现的 benchmark outcome。它们说明所提 metric 能区分指定 task 上的模型/配置行为，但不能证明 data quality、simulator fidelity、replayability 或 training suitability。

论文内部还存在实质性不一致。Table 7 与紧随其后的 persona-analysis prose 对若干 persona 给出不同 recovery value，因此在 raw metric input 被调和前，不应复用 persona-specific recovery 数字。论文所述 source component 相加为 314，不能透明得到 315-task total。abstract 的 2,835 条 sequence 也没有连接到可访问的 record manifest；用 315 × 3 个 model × 3 次 run 解释仍是 arithmetic inference。

构造与 QA 的证据属于程序描述，而不是 release-level verification。Appendix A 给出 task schema、每批 10 个 candidate 的生成、5 个 Markdown reference、人工 database/tool check 与 goal-shift integration。Appendix B 声称使用 3 次 run、state reset、10% task review、criteria cross-check、inter-rater reliability analysis 与持续更新，但可访问正文没有发布 generator/judge/simulator configuration、annotator statistic、rejected item、raw run table 或 revision history。

artifact 证据止于官方列出层面。MTI-LLM OpenReview 页面确实提供 supplementary-material endpoint，论文也称 full benchmark、harness configuration 与 experiment 已在此发布；但由于 ZIP 本身无法取回，本卡不声称已经检查 code、task JSON、run log、split file、license、hash 或 replay fixture。也没有确认独立的官方 GitHub、project page 或 Hugging Face dataset。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The relevant prior-work baseline is static customer-service agent evaluation over tau-bench-like APIs: an assistant receives a user request, calls tools, and is scored on task completion. AgentChangeBench changes the task object by adding personas, ordered goals, a declared number of required shifts, progression rules, hidden shift markers, and timestamps for acknowledgment, first relevant tool use, and outcome after each change.

The concrete novelty is the decomposition of goal-shift behavior. TSR keeps communication, action execution, and natural-language assertions separate; TUE exposes correctness and parameter validity; TCRR measures local exact-call redundancy; GSRT exposes acknowledgment, tool, and outcome latency plus a binary recovery rule. This creates an audit surface where an agent can complete the original goal yet adapt slowly, communicate poorly, repeat calls, or acknowledge a change without producing the shifted outcome.

The constituent techniques are not individually new. The work reuses tau-bench-derived customer-service environments, LLM user simulation, tool/API validation, LLM-as-judge communication assessment, persona conditioning, and transcript-derived metrics. Its five personas, three domains, three proprietary model families, and task scale are an engineering integration and evaluation expansion, not evidence of a new verifier class or training method.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that environment/trajectory benchmarks should represent changing objectives and expose multiple feedback channels instead of one terminal pass/fail label. The quality signal is schema and metric specificity, not high model scores. Reuse still requires an inspectable task-to-run manifest, reconciled counts and persona results, a pinned environment and judge stack, calibrated false-positive/false-negative behavior, retained failures, explicit splits/decontamination, and a license covering inherited templates, generated episodes, data, and code.

相关 prior-work baseline 是运行在 tau-bench-like API 上的静态客服 agent evaluation：assistant 接收 user request、调用工具，并按 task completion 得分。AgentChangeBench 对 task object 的改变，是加入 persona、ordered goals、声明的 required shift 数量、progression rule、hidden shift marker，以及每次变化后 acknowledgment、first relevant tool use 与 outcome 的时间点。

具体新意在于分解 goal-shift behavior。TSR 分开保留 communication、action execution 与 natural-language assertion；TUE 暴露 correctness 与 parameter validity；TCRR 衡量局部 exact-call redundancy；GSRT 暴露 acknowledgment、tool、outcome latency 以及 binary recovery rule。由此形成一个可审计 surface：agent 可能完成原始 goal，却对变化响应缓慢、communication 不佳、重复调用工具，或仅确认变化而没有产出 shifted outcome。

各组成技术本身并非新发明。论文复用了 tau-bench-derived customer-service environment、LLM user simulation、tool/API validation、LLM-as-judge communication assessment、persona conditioning 与 transcript-derived metric。5 个 persona、3 个 domain、3 个闭源 model family 与 task scale 属于工程整合和评测扩展，不是新的 verifier class 或 training method 的证据。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是 environment/trajectory benchmark 应表示变化中的 objective，并暴露多个 feedback channel，而不只给一个 terminal pass/fail label。质量信号来自 schema 与 metric 的具体性，而不是高 model score。复用仍需要可检查的 task-to-run manifest、调和后的 count 与 persona result、固定的 environment/judge stack、经过校准的 false-positive/false-negative behavior、保留的 failure、明确 split/decontamination，以及覆盖 inherited template、generated episode、data 与 code 的 license。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Scope and task model. The benchmark covers benign personas in banking, airline, and retail. Goal shifts are predeclared, ordered, and often explicit. It does not test implicit, ambiguous, interleaved, adversarial, browser, OS, code, or robotic changes. Results therefore do not establish robustness to unrestricted goal drift or real customers.
  • Recovery definition. GSRT's binary recovery predicate requires acknowledgment and no human transfer; relevant tool use and shifted-goal outcome are timed but do not determine recovery. This can produce a false positive when an agent politely recognizes the change but does not act or succeed. A detector miss can produce a false negative. The shift detector model, prompt, calibration, repetition policy, and error rate are undisclosed.
  • Judge dependence. gpt-4o-mini judges communication from the transcript, but the exact snapshot, prompt, temperature, calibration, and repeated-judgment protocol are unknown. Scores may move with style, verbosity, phrasing, or service updates. Natural-language assertions and task-specific predicates can also omit semantic requirements or reward benchmark-specific behavior.
  • Metric blind spots. TCRR catches exact duplicate calls in a three-turn window or excess same-function calls, but can miss semantically redundant calls whose arguments differ and can penalize justified retries after transient failures. API/schema validity is not the same as selecting the correct action sequence, and a weighted TSR can conceal which component failed.
  • Construction uncertainty. The task generator, full prompt, decoding settings, batch count, acceptance yield, rejected candidates, item-level lineage, and review decisions are not disclosed. The claimed 10% manual audit lacks annotator count, sampling rule, agreement statistic, adjudication, and revision history. Hidden generator/simulator traits may therefore shape the benchmark.
  • Count and result inconsistencies. The stated source components add to 314 rather than the reported 315 tasks. The 2,835-sequence claim lacks a task/run manifest. Table 7 conflicts with the following persona-recovery prose. These issues prevent record-level scale and persona-result auditing until the underlying artifact is reconciled.
  • Release and replay. The supplementary ZIP is officially listed but was not retrievable. No inspected manifest establishes task files, harness code, database snapshots, dependencies, checksums, per-run logs, split, success/failure retention, or replay instructions. Closed-model endpoints, unknown simulator/judge seeds, and an unpinned tau-bench-derived environment further prevent exact historical replay.
  • Rights, splits, and contamination. The paper licenses differ across arXiv (CC BY 4.0) and MTI-LLM OpenReview (CC BY-ND 4.0); neither establishes a code/dataset/trajectory license. The rights chain for inherited tau-bench templates and model-generated records is unknown. No train/dev/test manifest or decontamination protocol is disclosed, and public inherited tasks create benchmark-exposure risk.
  • Version drift. arXiv v1 lists eight authors, while the official MTI presentation surface lists five; a parallel LAW @ NeurIPS 2025 record uses another note ID and workshop footer. Citations and supplements must name the chosen surface, note ID, version, and access date rather than combining them into an imaginary immutable release.
  • Use boundary. The paper evaluates agents and does not report SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, process supervision, RLVR, or agent training. Benchmark performance is not proof of trajectory quality or training utility. Until release contents, license, split, lineage, failures, and replay are verified, the resource is safe for evaluation analysis only.

• 范围与 task model。 benchmark 只覆盖 banking、airline 与 retail 中的 benign persona。goal shift 预先声明、按顺序发生且通常明确提示；它没有测试 implicit、ambiguous、interleaved、adversarial、browser、OS、code 或 robotic change。因此结果不能证明对无限制 goal drift 或真实客户的 robustness。
  • Recovery 定义。 GSRT 的 binary recovery predicate 只要求 acknowledgment 且没有 human transfer；relevant tool use 与 shifted-goal outcome 虽然被计时，却不决定 recovery。当 agent 礼貌确认变化但没有行动或成功时，这可能产生 false positive；detector 漏检则可能产生 false negative。shift detector 的 model、prompt、calibration、repetition policy 与 error rate 均未披露。
  • Judge 依赖。 gpt-4o-mini 从 transcript 判断 communication，但准确 snapshot、prompt、temperature、calibration 与 repeated-judgment protocol 为 unknown。score 可能随 style、verbosity、措辞或服务更新而变化。natural-language assertion 与 task-specific predicate 也可能遗漏语义要求，或奖励 benchmark-specific behavior。
  • Metric 盲点。 TCRR 能发现三轮窗口内的 exact duplicate call 或同一 function 的过量调用，但可能漏掉 argument 不同、语义上重复的 call，也可能惩罚瞬时故障后的合理 retry。API/schema validity 不等于选择了正确 action sequence，加权 TSR 还可能掩盖具体失败 component。
  • 构造不确定性。 task generator、完整 prompt、decoding setting、batch 数、acceptance yield、rejected candidate、逐条 lineage 与 review decision 均未披露。声称的 10% manual audit 缺少 annotator 数、sampling rule、agreement statistic、adjudication 与 revision history。隐藏的 generator/simulator trait 因而可能塑造 benchmark。
  • 计数与结果冲突。 已陈述 source component 相加为 314，而论文报告 315 个 task；2,835-sequence claim 没有 task/run manifest；Table 7 又与后续 persona-recovery prose 冲突。在底层 artifact 被调和前，这些问题阻止 record-level scale 与 persona-result audit。
  • Release 与 replay。 supplementary ZIP 虽被官方列出，但无法取回。没有经过检查的 manifest 能证明 task file、harness code、database snapshot、dependency、checksum、逐 run log、split、success/failure retention 或 replay instruction。闭源 model endpoint、未知 simulator/judge seed 与未固定的 tau-bench-derived environment 进一步阻止准确历史 replay。
  • 权利、split 与 contamination。 arXiv 的论文 license 为 CC BY 4.0，MTI-LLM OpenReview 显示 CC BY-ND 4.0；两者都不能建立 code/dataset/trajectory license。inherited tau-bench template 与 model-generated record 的 rights chain 为 unknown。论文没有披露 train/dev/test manifest 或 decontamination protocol，公开继承 task 还会产生 benchmark-exposure risk。
  • 版本漂移。 arXiv v1 列出 8 位作者，MTI 官方 presentation surface 显示 5 位；另一个 LAW @ NeurIPS 2025 record 使用不同 note ID 与 workshop footer。citation 与 supplement 必须注明选择的 surface、note ID、version 与 access date，不能把它们合并成虚构的 immutable release。
  • 用途边界。 论文评测 agent，没有报告 SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、process supervision、RLVR 或 agent training。benchmark performance 不是 trajectory quality 或 training utility 的证据。在 release content、license、split、lineage、failure 与 replay 被核验前，该资源只适合 evaluation analysis。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, AgentChangeBench is useful as an evaluation schema and audit checklist for episodes whose objective changes mid-conversation. A researcher can represent the initial task and state, ordered goals, hidden shift event, user/assistant messages, assistant tool calls, API observations, acknowledgment/tool/outcome timing, transfer decision, and component scores as separate fields rather than reducing the trajectory to final success.

The metric decomposition supports controlled failure analysis. Evaluators can ask whether a model acknowledged a new goal without acting, used the right tool with invalid parameters, repeated exact calls, transferred unnecessarily, or completed the changed objective slowly. A stronger study could label a blinded subset with humans, compare multiple communication judges and shift detectors, perturb transcripts for style/verbosity sensitivity, and estimate false positives and false negatives for API assertions, TCRR, and recovery.

The task-construction description is a partial benchmark recipe: analyze a domain, define tools, create a declarative schema, provide reference files to a generator, manually check tool/database consistency and user-visible information, attach personas and ordered shifts, run a controlled user-agent-tool episode, and calculate mixed metrics. Anyone adapting this recipe should additionally preserve generator prompts and versions, rejected candidates, item-level provenance, reviewer decisions, environment snapshots, per-run seeds, and all successful and failed trajectories.

The paper is also a useful release-audit case. The 315-versus-314 reconciliation gap, unexplained 315-to-2,835 mapping, Table 7/persona prose conflict, MTI/LAW/author-list version drift, and inaccessible supplementary ZIP show why a benchmark card must distinguish an official listing from an inspected reusable artifact. These are concrete checks for future environment and trajectory releases.

The safe reuse class is evaluation and audit reference only. The paper supports comparing agent behavior under a fixed, reconstructed setup and designing more explicit goal-shift evaluations. It does not support using the records as SFT demonstrations, preference pairs, reward-model data, process labels, RLVR rewards, or agent-training rollouts. Training reuse is blocked by unverified release contents, license, split, lineage, failure retention, judge calibration, and replay metadata.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，AgentChangeBench 可作为一套 evaluation schema 与 audit checklist，用于目标在对话中途变化的 episode。研究者可以把 initial task/state、ordered goals、hidden shift event、user/assistant message、assistant tool call、API observation、acknowledgment/tool/outcome timing、transfer decision 与 component score 表示成独立字段，而不是把 trajectory 压缩为 final success。

metric decomposition 支持受控 failure analysis。评测者可以检查模型是否只确认新 goal 而没有行动、使用正确 tool 却给出无效 parameter、重复完全相同的 call、不必要地 transfer，或过慢完成 changed objective。更强的研究可以对 blind subset 做 human label，比较多个 communication judge 与 shift detector，对 transcript 做 style/verbosity perturbation，并估计 API assertion、TCRR 与 recovery 的 false positive 和 false negative。

task-construction 描述构成一套不完整的 benchmark recipe：分析 domain、定义 tool、创建 declarative schema、向 generator 提供 reference file、人工检查 tool/database consistency 与 user-visible information、加入 persona 与 ordered shift、运行受控 user-agent-tool episode，并计算 mixed metric。任何复用者都应额外保留 generator prompt/version、rejected candidate、逐条 provenance、reviewer decision、environment snapshot、逐 run seed，以及全部 successful/failed trajectory。

论文也是一个有用的 release-audit 案例。315 对 314 的调和缺口、未解释的 315-to-2,835 mapping、Table 7/persona prose 冲突、MTI/LAW/author-list version drift 与无法取回的 supplementary ZIP，共同说明 benchmark card 必须区分“官方列出”与“已经检查、可复用的 artifact”。这些都是未来 environment 与 trajectory release 的具体审计项。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit reference。论文支持在固定且重建后的 setup 中比较 agent behavior，也能帮助设计更明确的 goal-shift evaluation；它不支持把记录当作 SFT demonstration、preference pair、reward-model data、process label、RLVR reward 或 agent-training rollout。未核验的 release content、license、split、lineage、failure retention、judge calibration 与 replay metadata 阻断训练复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start from the object, not the score: 315 declarative tasks become user-agent-tool episodes with API observations, shift timestamps, TSR/TUE/TCRR/GSRT components, and transfer events; the exact released serialization remains unverified.
  • Keep the feedback mixed: environment/API checks and transcript-derived redundancy coexist with a gpt-4o-mini communication judge and an undisclosed goal-shift detector. Recovery means acknowledgment plus no human transfer, not verified completion of the changed goal.
  • Do not silently convert 315 tasks into 2,835 released records. The multiplication by three models and three runs is plausible curator arithmetic, while the source counts themselves sum to 314 and require artifact-level reconciliation.
  • Read Table 5 for the model comparisons, then inspect Table 7 and its following paragraph before quoting persona results; those two sources conflict. None of the benchmark scores proves data quality or training utility.
  • Treat the supplement as listed but uninspected. Pin the MTI OpenReview note, arXiv version, author list, environment/judge versions, license, split, checksums, failure retention, and replay manifest before reuse; the parallel LAW record is version drift.

• 先看 object，不要先看 score：315 个 declarative task 生成带 API observation、shift timestamp、TSR/TUE/TCRR/GSRT component 与 transfer event 的 user-agent-tool episode；准确 release serialization 仍未核验。
  • feedback 必须视为 mixed：environment/API check 与 transcript-derived redundancy 同时存在，另有 gpt-4o-mini communication judge 和未披露的 goal-shift detector。recovery 表示 acknowledgment 加上没有 human transfer，不等于已经验证 changed goal 完成。
  • 不要把 315 个 task 悄悄改写成 2,835 条 released record。乘以 3 个 model 与 3 次 run 只是合理的 curator arithmetic；source count 本身相加为 314，也需要 artifact-level reconciliation。
  • 模型比较应读 Table 5；引用 persona result 前必须对照 Table 7 与其后段落，因为两处互相冲突。任何 benchmark score 都不能证明 data quality 或 training utility。
  • supplement 只能标记为“官方列出但未检查”。复用前要固定 MTI OpenReview note、arXiv version、author list、environment/judge version、license、split、checksum、failure retention 与 replay manifest；parallel LAW record 属于 version drift。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: gpt-4o-mini communication judgments can change with prompt, model snapshot, style, verbosity, and calibration; the exact judge configuration is undisclosed.
Goal-shift recovery depends on post-hoc LLM detection and counts acknowledgment plus no human transfer as recovery even if relevant tool use or the shifted outcome is missing.
TCRR catches exact duplicate calls in a local window but may miss semantically redundant calls with changed arguments or penalize justified retries after transient errors.
Tool/API predicates and natural-language assertions can omit requirements, create false positives/negatives, or reward benchmark-specific behavior.
Predeclared and often explicitly signaled shifts, benign personas, and three customer-service domains limit ecological validity.
Closed-model endpoints, an unpinned tau-bench-derived harness/database, and unknown simulator/judge seeds prevent exact replay.
Public task/evaluator exposure and inherited tau-bench templates create contamination and benchmark-gaming risk.
The 315-task source arithmetic, 2,835-sequence mapping, and inconsistent persona-recovery numbers require artifact-level reconciliation.
